Draw interval glyphs: point estimates, one-sided bounds and intervals

Source: R/seq_interval_glyph.R
seq_interval_glyph.Rd

Draws one glyph per row at genomic position x and value y, with a vertical bar from bar_lo to bar_hi. The glyph type is read per row from the glyph mapping:

Usage

seq_interval_glyph(
  data = NULL,
  mapping = NULL,
  aesthetics = aes(),
  legend = NULL,
  legend_labels = NULL,
  legend_all = FALSE,
  legend_extra = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  legend_position = "canvas_margin",
  legend_side = "right",
  ...
)

Arguments

data

GRanges. Falls back to the parent track's data.

mapping

SeqMap from map(). Fields: x (default start), y, bar_lo, bar_hi, glyph (default "point"), color, alpha, label (printed right of the glyph when not NA) and caution (logical; draws a small caution triangle).

aesthetics

SeqAes from aes(): size (point size in mm, default 2), bar_linewidth (4), bar_alpha (1; multiplies the row alpha for bars), cap_mm (2.5), glyph_points (TRUE), label_cex (0.6), label_mm (1.5), caution_mm (1.6), color, alpha.

legend

NULL (keys for the glyph types present, from seq_glyph_legend_keys()), FALSE (no legend), a SeqLegendSpec, or a list of LegendKey objects used as given.

legend_labels

Named character relabelling the auto keys by glyph type, e.g. c(point = "estimate").

legend_all

Logical. Show keys for all five drawn glyph types.

legend_extra

Optional LegendKey or list of them appended to the legend.

show_legend

Logical. FALSE suppresses the legend.

legend_position, legend_side

Placement of the built legend. Default "canvas_margin", "right".

...

Unused.

Value

A SeqIntervalGlyph element.

Details

  • "point": filled point at y and a solid bar from bar_lo to bar_hi.

  • "latest": cap at y and an open bar from y down to bar_lo.

  • "earliest": cap at y and an open bar from y up to bar_hi.

  • "interval": bracket from bar_lo to bar_hi, plus a point at y when y is not NA.

  • "untimed": nothing is drawn.

  • "hidden": the row is dropped.

A row with NA y gets no point and no cap. All values are drawn as given. coordCanvas[[w]] holds one data.frame per window with columns row, glyph, x, y, lo, hi, color, alpha, label, caution (canvas npc).

Examples

library(GenomicRanges)
gr <- GRanges("chr1", IRanges(c(2e5, 5e5, 8e5), width = 1),
              y = c(0.4, 0.6, NA), lo = c(0.3, 0.2, 0.5),
              hi = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.9),
              g = c("point", "latest", "interval"))
el <- seq_interval_glyph(gr, map(y = y, bar_lo = lo, bar_hi = hi,
                                 glyph = g))
